reviews.text: I have been using pinger since 2013 when I was a kid with a iPad and iPod and I could now call my parents! Now grown up and owning a business I have found my way back to pinger using it as a business line. It’s been perfect for my business and customers, and great to keep my personal and business separate. Being compatible with many devices, I never miss a text or call - improving my business. All in all Pinger and their sister companies have been flawless dating all the way back when I made my first phone call.
